mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_order WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_order (order_no, appointment_id, tenant_id, house_id, landlord_id, deposit, monthly_rent, status, start_date, next_due_period, paid_months, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{appointmentId}, #{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{landlordId}, #{deposit}, #{monthlyRent}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{nextDuePeriod}, #{paidMonths}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE rent_order SET status = 2, start_date = #{startDate}, next_due_period = #{nextDuePeriod}, paid_months = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE rent_order SET next_due_period = #{nextDuePeriod}, paid_months = paid_months + #{addMonths}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND next_due_period = #{expectedPeriod}
UPDATE rent_order SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE rent_order SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
UPDATE rent_order SET status = 5, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_order WHERE status = 2 AND next_due_period IS NOT NULL AND #{today} >= DATE_SUB( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(next_due_period, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL #{beforeDays} DAY) ORDER BY id
